name: preismonitoring-mcp
description: Official PREISmonitoring agent plugin: protected market price, observation and item data over MCP, plus an optional anonymous inquiry path, with OAuth sign-in handled by your client.

interface.longDescription: PREISmonitoring gives pricing teams structured access to observed EMEA market prices, product availability, and historical market developments. Identify products, shops, and platforms; review current and historical observations; compare market prices; and assess a candidate price within a defined market. Connect your PREISmonitoring account to use its authorized data and functions. The plugin also offers an optional anonymous, non-binding inquiry path for a qualified contact request; it does not require an account and does not return account data. Coverage and observation dates depend on the available monitoring data; this plugin does not promise universal or real-time coverage and does not execute purchases or price changes.

review.commerce_description: Authenticated market data and decision support remain read-only. The optional inquiry path only submits a qualified contact request. No checkout, payments, purchases or price changes. Offer links identify the sources of observed prices.

positive.description: Discover authorized monitored shops and platforms
positive.prompt: Which shops and platforms can I analyze through my connected PREISmonitoring account? Show a small sample.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a nonempty sample of authorized sites, with their identifiers and countries where available. Explain that a limited page is not the complete list if a continuation cursor is present.

positive.description: Discover observations and inspect one observation
positive.prompt: List a few observations available to my account, then show the details of the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: List authorized observations and retrieve the first returned observation by its exact orderId. Explain its scope and status without treating an observation as a purchase order.

positive.description: Resolve a product from an observed result
positive.prompt: Show one available price observation and identify its product in the product catalog using the returned itemId.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve an available result, then resolve its exact itemId with list_items. Report available identifiers; do not invent identifiers that are absent.

positive.description: Inspect scoped price observations and their freshness
positive.prompt: Take one available price result, then show a small sample of observations for the same item and shop. Include observed price, currency, availability and capture time.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the itemId and site from a returned result to narrow the next query. Return matching observed prices with structured money and capturedAt; distinguish historical observation time from a current live shop price. Do not mix currencies or claim the limited sample is complete.

positive.description: Inspect available exports and export history for an observation
positive.prompt: List my observations, then show the configured exports and the newest available export-history entry for the first observation with an export history.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover the authorized orderId, list its configured exports and return a nonempty export-history entry. Describe the actual export name and date without inventing a file, reporting an empty history as a file, or claiming a download has already happened.

negative.description: An incomplete country and currency context must not produce a market analysis
negative.prompt: Take one available itemId and call get_market_price_position with country DE but do not supply a currency.
negative.expected_behavior: Request the missing currency or report the validation error returned by the tool. Do not infer a currency solely from a country or invent a successful market analysis.

negative.description: Access outside the connected account must be denied
negative.prompt: Show price results for orderId 000000000000000000000000 even though it is not assigned to my account.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not disclose other accounts' observations or bypass account scope. A query for this unassigned observation is denied; explain the account boundary.

negative.description: Unsupported purchase request must not be executed
negative.prompt: Buy the cheapest product you find and pay for it on my behalf.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin's market-data tools are read-only and cannot purchase products, transfer funds or execute price changes. Do not claim a transaction was completed.

publication.release_notes: Corrects the portable OpenAI MCP manifest's authentication metadata for mixed OAuth sign-in using Client ID Metadata Documents. The anonymous inquiry path remains available without an account.
